messages:
nicole: FluxBio just escalated SUP-12011 — they were billed a $5.7k burst on their Dedicated commit after an emergency regional failover on 2026-06-18. They want an immediate credit and a short explanation for their SOC team.
ben-fin: Paste invoice lines please.
tara-cs: INV-6205 snippet:
```
INV-6205
- Reserved commit (Jun): $7,200
- Burst overage (06/18 22:03-22:29 UTC): $5,700
Total due: $12,900
```
platform-bot: Incident: region-failover-us-east->eu-north at 2026-06-18T22:02Z. Routing cutover lasted ~26 minutes. Autoscaler spun 5 extra nodes. (link to incident INC-2026-332)
metering-bot: Metering report: 85 GPU-hours billed as burst. Raw event stream attached.
ben-fin: Contract note: commits are regional. Failover billing is chargeable unless there was an SLA breach or a documented platform action that caused duplicate provisioning. Any sign of that?
platform-bot: Postmortem draft shows allocator race on failover path, causing overlapping node lifecycles for ~9 minutes. That likely inflated billed hours. See timeline in postmortem.
legal: We should be careful with wording to customer — avoid admitting a platform defect until postmortem finalized. But we can offer a provisional credit pending reconciliation.
tara-cs: Customer insists it was our platform and wants full refund. They provided p99 traces showing spikes but not full outage.
ben-fin: Proposal: run a metering reconciliation to estimate duplicate hours. If duplicates exist, issue a pro-rata credit limited to duplicate hours. Also offer a one-time 5% reserved-commit credit next invoice as goodwill. Approve?
nicole: CS supports provisional credit and goodwill. We need text for the SOC: brief timeline, credit applied, and follow-up remediation.
ben-fin: I ran quick math: if 9 minutes of duplicate provisioning maps to ~30 GPU-hours duplicated => at rate $66/hr -> $1,980 credit. Propose provisional CN-6205-PROV $2,000. Final amount to be set after full reconciliation.
metering-bot: Reconciliation job kicked off. ETA 4h. (job ID MR-4472)
billing-bot: Created provisional credit CN-6205-PROV $2,000 and placed collection hold on INV-6205. Tag: reason=failover-provisional-credit.
legal: Approve provisional credit language. Suggest note: "We are applying a provisional credit while we complete a detailed reconciliation; final adjustment will be communicated within 5 business days."
ben-fin: Filing FIN-1128: "Failover duplicate provisioning billing rule" to product + platform — propose policy to zero-rate duplicate node-hours during failovers once allocator overlap is detected. Assigning to platform owner.
platform-bot: Acknowledged. Also adding instrumentation task to surface allocator overlap events to billing pipeline.
tara-cs: I'll message FluxBio: confirm provisional credit applied, hold on collection, and timeline for final reconciliation & SOC note.
nicole: Customer reply: appreciates the provisional credit, asks for the SOC note ASAP.
ben-fin: Once reconciliation finishes, we'll post final CN and close hold. If final credit < provisional, we'll net the difference; if >, we'll post the incremental CN.
billing-bot: Note: Refund queued if payment already captured. Refund timing depends on payment processor.
ben-fin: Thanks team. Please keep this thread updated when MR-4472 completes. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
